decisions.rationale: Candidate c was chosen first, but TRELLIS rebuilt it twice as a cross of two troughs (c-s6110, and a-s6122 from candidate a); candidate b, the same plank trough on stone blocks with dark water, reconstructs as one long trough (b-s6121).

Plank water trough on stone blocks with leaves on the water (Azure concept b, TRELLIS b-s6121). Cooked 3,939 triangles, 114,116 bytes; 0.86 m tall in a 1.64 m reach at uniform scale. Albedo 256 px with 256 px normal and ORM maps (texture memory budget), albedoGain 2.0 against TRELLIS's darkened bake. Reviewed in four views beside the 2.25 m soldier.
limitations: The water is a dark static surface (no reflection).
